name: Declarative Form AJAX
description: Allows for form elements to declare AJAX update dependencies.
project_description: Declarative Form AJAX provides a simpler way for Form API elements to be updated via AJAX in response to another element having its value changed. Similarly to core's #states system, it uses a declarative syntax on the form array rather than hand-wired #ajax callbacks: an element declares which other element(s) it is 'updated_by', and a single form-level #after_build callback (FormAjax::ajaxAfterBuild) walks the form and wires up the triggering elements and the AJAX callback. When a controlling element changes, FormAjax::ajaxCallback re-renders every dependent element and returns InsertCommand responses that replace them in place, chaining any pre-existing AJAX callback the triggering element already had. The project ships a demo submodule (declarative_form_ajax_demo) with working example forms. It is described by its author as a proof of concept for a Drupal core issue that can also be used as a contrib dependency.
